### Rayonier Announces $300 Million Increase in Share Repurchase Authorization


November 4, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/242204114/files/doc_news/Rayonier-Announces-300-Million-Increase-in-Share-Repurchase-Authorization-2026.pdf)


WILDLIGHT, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Rayonier Inc. (NYSE:RYN) today announced that its Board of Directors has approved a $300 million increase to the Company’s existing share repurchase authorization. This increase is in addition to the approximately $51 million that remained under the existing authorization as of October 30, 2026. Repurchases may be made at management’s discretion from time to time on the open market, in privately negotiated transactions, or by other means, including Rule 10b5-1 trading plans. The repurchase program has no expiration date, may be suspended or discontinued at any time, and does not obligate the Company to acquire any particular amount of shares.


“The increase to our share repurchase authorization provides us additional capacity to capitalize on the significant disconnect between public and private timberland values,” said Mark McHugh, President and Chief Executive Officer of Rayonier. “Share repurchases remain an important component of our capital allocation strategy, and we will continue to deploy capital opportunistically to enhance long-term shareholder value.”


As of October 30, 2026, the Company had approximately 295.1 million common shares and 1.6 million operating partnership units outstanding.


**About Rayonier**


Rayonier is a land resources real estate investment trust (REIT) with a portfolio comprising over four million acres in the U.S. South and U.S. Northwest. The company is focused on managing its timberlands on a sustainable basis while optimizing its overall portfolio value by delivering land to its highest and best use. Rayonier also operates six sawmills, an industrial-grade plywood mill, residential and commercial real estate developments, and a rural land sales program. Rayonier is committed to corporate responsibility, third-party forest certification, and supporting climate change mitigation through its land-based solutions business. More information is available at[www.rayonier.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.rayonier.com&esheet=54635393&newsitemid=20261104944795&lan=en-US&anchor=www.rayonier.com&index=1&md5=f9c7c682293d7f605a4fd543b19cf00f) .
